messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tapering dose is required after more than a few days"
set: ["tapering dose is required after more than a few days", "do not stop suddenly after more than a few days of treatment", "weight gain over a few days", "drowsiness may go away after a few days of treatment", "after dose is lowered", "takes a few days to clear fully", "more than a year later", "reassess blood pressure after a few weeks", "dose is higher than needed", "dose increase no more often than once a week", "drowsiness is not required for effectiveness", "if more than 4 days have passed, skip the missed dose", "skip the missed dose if more than 5 days have passed", "tell your doctor if side effects last for more than a few weeks", "increase is needed if additional glycemic control is required", "follow doctor's instructions about tapering dose"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
